title: Bou's Third Run

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Hey, good timing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, good timing.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Yeah. It's a minute and a half until the next ad break in the HOVA derby match. Ninety seconds of bliss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. It's a minute and a half until the next ad break in the HOVA derby match. Ninety seconds of bliss.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Ugh, some days are great, some days are trash. It’s the people who make the whole thing worth it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh, some days are great, some days are trash. It’s the people who make the whole thing worth it.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Mmm, you're ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmm, you're ok.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Definitely like you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Definitely like you.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Oh my friend, there are always deliveries. You wanna help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh my friend, there are always deliveries. You wanna help?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Nice! Before we start, some space guy showed up here a while ago. Do you know him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice! Before we start, some space guy showed up here a while ago. Do you know him?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Nice. Here we go, rush hour starting in three, two, one…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice. Here we go, rush hour starting in three, two, one…

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: I get it. You want a coffee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it. You want a coffee?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Here you go. Thanks for stopping by CoffeePoccoCup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here you go. Thanks for stopping by CoffeePoccoCup.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Well, thanks for stopping by CoffeePoccoCup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, thanks for stopping by CoffeePoccoCup.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: We got a blue cheese pour-over with extra ice, a mushroom mocha with white truffle syrup, a black ultra grande and a tequila corretto.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We got a blue cheese pour-over with extra ice, a mushroom mocha with white truffle syrup, a black ultra grande and a tequila corretto.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Eh, never mind. Right, rush hours starting in three, two, one...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, never mind. Right, rush hours starting in three, two, one...

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: He stood here for like an hour watching the slow drip and saying "wow". What's that about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He stood here for like an hour watching the slow drip and saying "wow". What's that about?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Guess that explains it. He, err… this is kind of embarrassing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess that explains it. He, err… this is kind of embarrassing.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: It's nothing. No time anyway, coffee rush hour starting in three, two, one...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nothing. No time anyway, coffee rush hour starting in three, two, one...

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: He asked me out to dinner. Was all excited about some place that does hanging kebabs… should I go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He asked me out to dinner. Was all excited about some place that does hanging kebabs… should I go?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Hmm, he seemed genuine at least. And I could use a meal that isn’t the congealed gunge from the bottom of the syrup pumps. What the heck, I'll go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm, he seemed genuine at least. And I could use a meal that isn’t the congealed gunge from the bottom of the syrup pumps. What the heck, I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Yeah, productivity is everything right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, productivity is everything right?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Thanks for being honest. Now are you ready for some orders?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for being honest. Now are you ready for some orders?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Ha! No one’s ever called me that before.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! No one’s ever called me that before.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Oh. Really? Listen, I don't wanna get in the way of anything...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh. Really? Listen, I don't wanna get in the way of anything...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Quiet time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Quiet time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you even like your job?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you even like your job?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you even like your job?

nodes.text: Like me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So no deliveries right now?

nodes.text: Count me IN.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, kinda busy today.

nodes.text: No, I'm good.

nodes.text: Hit me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you mean Cassius?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you mean Cassius?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No idea who that could be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No idea who that could be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No idea who that could be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No idea who that could be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He grew up in space. Gravity’s a new one on him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He grew up in space. Gravity’s a new one on him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He grew up in space. Gravity’s a new one on him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He grew up in space. Gravity’s a new one on him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you want to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you want to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He’s supposed to be running a hotel, not dating.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He’s supposed to be running a hotel, not dating.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He’s supposed to be running a hotel, not dating.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He’s supposed to be running a hotel, not dating.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not? He seems nice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not? He seems nice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure am.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've changed my mind. I'll help another time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've changed my mind. I'll help another time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I've changed my mind. I'll help another time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I've changed my mind. I'll help another time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No problem, boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No problem, boss.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He asked me out too...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He asked me out too...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There isn't anything to get in the way of.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There isn't anything to get in the way of.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There isn't anything to get in the way of.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There isn't anything to get in the way of.

nodes.text: Yeah, he asked me first, so...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, he asked me first, so...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, he asked me first, so...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, he asked me first, so...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's see what happens.

nodes.text: Sure, it's a good opportunity to meet people.
